name: Shorty Edit
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Turn your business footage into product ads, customer testimonials, and branded demos for social media, websites, and sales presentations. Tell Shorty your audience, key message, and desired style, or provide a reference video. Shorty can analyze clips, assemble edits, add captions and transitions, apply your supplied brand direction, and render a downloadable video. Review the result and request revisions directly in ChatGPT. An existing Shorty account with sufficient credits is required. Use only media you own or have permission to process.
summary_ja: 手持ちの映像から商品広告や顧客の声、ブランド紹介動画を編集する。
limitations_ja: 既存のShortyアカウントと十分なクレジットが必要。
